summary: Wrote a 4-phase, 3-wave plan gating the formal extension's mandatory Mathlib-lookup step on (a) a Lean target and (b) lookup-tool registration, with skip-and-log as an accepted degraded mode. Phase 1 authors and REGISTERS one shared context/patterns/mathlib-lookup-gate.md; Phases 2 and 3 run in parallel rewriting the four agent contracts and four skill wrappers to point at it; Phase 4 redeploys to RESULT=landed_verify_clean under the full gate set. Beyond the research report: the new context tier requires manifest.json provides.context and index-entries.json registration, so the file set is 11, not the 8 the report called 'already pinned'.
